text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
At lunchtime, students were crowding the school store.
At the very back of the line were Matikanetannhauser and the others.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
...I shall now deliver an oracle from Lady Shiraoki.
Matikanetannhauser is—

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: *Gulp*...! W-What about me...?

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Today's looking to be an absolute Great Blessing fever too!
There are signs of good fortune especially around lunchtime!!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Howaaaaaah!!
Then, does that mean we can eat the super popular bread that's always sold out!?

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Melon bread, cream bread, carrot breeead♪
Pan-pa-pa-paan!

text_block_list.name: School Store Lady
text_block_list.text:
Sorry, everyone~!
The melon pan, cream buns,
and carrot bread are all sold out~~!!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Wait, whaaat!?
Wasn't it supposed to be Great Blessing... !?

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: T-That's strange... Did I make a mistake with the divination method...?

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: No, no, I'm fine!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
It just means the great blessing I was meant to grasp
wasn't a piece of bread!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Let's check out a cafe this time!
Wait for me, my lucky~~♪

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Ah, please waaaait!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Curious about what Machikane Tannhauser and the others were up to,
I decided to follow them.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, look at this!
Look at this signboard!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: "New Menu: Stewed Carrot Hamburg Steak," limited to 10 servings... !?

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: "This has to be it! Today's Machi-san is destined to claim this rare lunch!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, the two of them stood in line
waiting for their turn to order, but...

text_block_list.name: Cafe Lady
text_block_list.text:
I'm so sorry~
The limited lunch special just sold out~

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Huh!? Sold out here too!?

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Whaaat?! W-What does this mean?!
Lady Shiraoki's fortune-telling was off not just once, but twice?!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Happiness is right in front of my eyes!
This doesn't make any sense at all!!
choice_data_list: You get so close, though, don't you…

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Trainer.
...So you saw that.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Ahaha... Falling just one step short of the goal does feel pretty typical of me, though...

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: But, but—

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
"Lunch break isn't over yet!
The bread and the limited lunch were sold out, but that just means an even luckier lunch is waiting for me!"

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Aaaaagh!
I see, so that's what it was!!
The key is Machi-san's unyielding fighting spirit...!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Face the headwind with a positive heart!
This must be the fortune predicting that super big luck is coming my way!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Yes, Fuku-chan-senpai!
This is definitely going to be an ultra-rare lunch!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
"Still, which way should I go to get some food?
Hmmm..."

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Where do you think it is, Trainer?
The super-rare lunch!
choice_data_list: Let's bite the bullet and head back to the school store!
Let's sit tight and wait for good fortune to come.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
I see~, getting back to basics, huh?
That might just work!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Yes! The divine omen originally said
"Good fortune lies at the school store," after all!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Aw man, completely sold out.
Where can I find that super rare lunch...?

text_block_list.name: School Store Lady
text_block_list.text:
Oh, perfect timing, you two!
Some newly released bread just arrived~.
Would you like to try some?

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Mmh, could this be...
'Ultra Delicious Muscat Bread'!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: It's amazing! I can smell the aroma of the fruit from all the way over here~!

text_block_list.name: Both
text_block_list.text: Thanks for the food♪

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The two of them relished the delicious bread
that no one had ever tasted before!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
I see, with how I am right now,
good luck will come looking for me instead!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Let us also perform a prayer to bring good fortune!
Hmmmmmm...!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Lunch is so yummy, munching and crunching!
Kyoeeeey!

text_block_list.name: Cafe Lady
text_block_list.text:
Oh my, you two.
Have you not had lunch yet, by any chance?

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
That's right.
I'm already completely starved~.

text_block_list.name: Cafe Lady
text_block_list.text:
Would you like some of my boxed lunch?
I'm stuffed from taste-testing lunch earlier.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, spring rolls, hamburg steaks, and oden...
There are so many side dishes!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
If it's a bento from the lady here, it's bound to be delicious!
So that's what the divine message meant!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Machikane Tannhauser and the others
thoroughly enjoyed their ultra-rare boxed lunches!
